title: No persona_min_assurance, so a consumer cannot gate on assurance at all
description:
grep for min_assurance across the repo returns zero hits. audience.rs:66 recognises only require_presence and max_age, and the persona_ namespace is CLOSED -- any other persona_* parameter is INVALID_ARGUMENT.

The only working lever is persona_require_presence=session, which does correctly refuse the unix claim (PresenceLevel::None fails at service.rs:316) but also refuses every ssh-agent, GPG and DID claim, all of which are iaa1/None. A consumer wanting 'IdP-verified, seat not required' has no expressible daemon-side policy.

This was tolerable when every source required a key. The unix attestor makes assurance the sole discriminator, so the missing lever now matters.
